summary.text: Historical data is provided by S&P Global Market Intelligence. Real-time stock price data is provided by CBOE and 15-minute delayed consolidated tape pricing data is provided by Nasdaq UTP. Several fund data points are also provided by Finnhub.

overview.description: The iShares Morningstar U.S. Equity ETF (ILCB) is an exchange-traded fund that is based on the Morningstar US Large-Mid Cap Market index. The fund tracks a market cap-weighted index consists of both growth and value stocks, selected from the top 90% of the US market-cap spectrum. ILCB was launched on Jun 28, 2004 and is issued by BlackRock.

holdings.infoBox: ILCB is an equity ETF with a total of 532 individual holdings. The top holdings are NVIDIA stock at 7.91%, Apple at 7.33%, Microsoft at 5.62%, Alphabet at 5.38%, and Amazon.com at 3.60%.
